title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are used to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic by resampling with replacement from the original data. In this problem, the replicates are given in rows, and their statistics are calculated.

title: Identifying the Correct Statistics
text: The rowvars column in the table represents the variances of each bootstrap replicate. Use these values to construct the confidence interval for the population variance.

title: Calculating the Confidence Interval
text: To construct a 50% confidence interval, find the 25th and 75th percentiles of the rowvars. These percentiles will give you the endpoints of the interval.

title: Finding the 25th Percentile
text: The 25th percentile of the rowvars is the value at the first quartile. What is this value?
